# netbox_inventory_item (Data Source)

An inventory item on a device (dcim.inventoryitem).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/inventoryitem/):

> Inventory items represent hardware components installed within a device, such as a power supply or CPU or line card. They are intended to be used primarily for inventory purposes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_inventory_item" "test" {
  name = "test-inventory_item"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_tag` (String) Unique asset tag.
- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `device_id` (Number) Id of the device.
- `discovered` (Boolean) Whether the item was discovered automatically.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent inventory item.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the inventory item role.
- `serial` (String) Serial number.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `component_id` (Number) Id of the device component named by component_type.
- `component_type` (String) Type of the device component the item is bound to, e.g. dcim.interface. Requires component_id.
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `part_id` (String) Manufacturer part number.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
